arguments.sql:
SELECT CAST(ROUND(AVG(u.Reputation)) AS INTEGER) AS average_reputation
FROM main.users AS u
WHERE u.Id IN (
    SELECT p.OwnerUserId
    FROM main.posts AS p
    WHERE p.Score < 20
      AND instr(p.Tags, '<r>') > 0
);
